annotation.interpretation_a: A STREAM frame with the FIN bit set can have zero length Stream Data.
annotation.interpretation_b: A STREAM frame with the FIN bit not set must have at least one byte of Stream Data.
annotation.justification: The clause states what is prohibited, but does not explicitly state what is allowed when the FIN bit is set. This creates ambiguity about whether zero-length Stream Data is permissible or required when FIN is set.
annotation.missing_information: It is unclear if a STREAM frame with the FIN bit set *may* have zero length Stream Data, or if it *must* have zero length Stream Data. The wording allows both interpretations.
